caseName: Behnke v. Committee on Professional Ethics & Conduct of Iowa State Bar Ass'n
caseNameFull: Behnke v. Committee on Professional Ethics and Conduct of Iowa State Bar Assn.

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Iowa. Application for stay of disciplinary sentence, presented to Mr. Justice Blackmun, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice Blackmun would grant the application.
